name: client-discovery-store-catalog-special-requests
executionConcern: client discovery, central catalog/store publication, marketing/media destinations and special-request intake
objective: Make every client-visible store/category/product/media/marketing/special-request state come from canonical DSH owners and proven publication gates, with no local catalog/publication truth and retry-safe special-request readback.
truthOwner: DSH owns store/publication/discovery/catalog consumption/marketing/special-request operational truth; Media owns governed binary objects; upstream field/partner/operator actions are bounded writers only.

tasks.objective: Close central catalog and store publication eligibility to client discovery
tasks.currentProblem: The client has real discovery/store routes, but current Product Truth makes visibility depend on canonical catalog plus partner/store/onboarding/marketing/serviceability gates; a store can therefore be wrong even when client UI code is correct.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace `list/get store` and home discovery from client through shared/generated DSH clients into store/centralcatalog/homediscovery publication rules and persistence; map every required upstream gate and repair the first canonical divergence. Remove any demo/local category/product/publication fallback.
tasks.targetState: Client search/home/store lists expose exactly the stores/categories/products currently eligible under canonical DSH publication and central catalog truth, never merely because an upstream surface says saved/success.
tasks.action: Correct DSH publication/catalog owner first; change field/partner/control writers only if they produce the incorrect canonical gate, then update client readback.
mustNotChange: Do not create a surface-local catalog/category/product truth.
Do not broaden field/partner/control work beyond publication inputs.
Do not treat cached discovery as checkout authorization.
acceptanceCriteria: A published eligible store/product appears consistently after canonical readback.
Every failed publication gate hides the store/product from client discovery.
Cross-scope/private partner onboarding data never appears in client responses.
Catalog identity/visibility comes from central canonical owner with no local duplicate.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused unit commit or roll forward at the canonical owner while preserving durable/audit evidence; never restore a parallel local truth or weaken a safety boundary.
tasks.commitBoundary: One U002 publication/catalog commit boundary, possibly owner plus tightly coupled consumer update; no independent onboarding/partner refactor.

tasks.objective: Close marketing/reels/media actions and deterministic navigation
tasks.currentProblem: Home marketing/reels can render content and external/store actions, but static routing does not prove targets remain authorized, existent, published and safe under missing/removed media or stale cached campaigns.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace marketing/reel payloads, media references and action targets through DSH contracts/owners and client navigation. Validate missing/invalid targets, external URL policy, media unavailability, RTL/accessibility and canonical refresh.
tasks.targetState: Every visible marketing/reel item is server-owned and routes deterministically to an allowed current target; stale/missing/invalid targets degrade without exposing unpublished content or crashing.
tasks.action: Fix DSH marketing/media reference owner before client presentation and navigation.
mustNotChange: Do not hardcode unpublished store IDs or campaign destinations.
Do not let external URLs bypass current allow/safety policy.
Do not convert missing media into fake success content.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing/deleted media has explicit fallback/error state.
Store action opens only current client-visible store.
External action follows current safe URL handling.
Reels/marketing refresh from canonical owner after publication changes.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused unit commit or roll forward at the canonical owner while preserving durable/audit evidence; never restore a parallel local truth or weaken a safety boundary.

tasks.objective: Close SHEIN/Awnak special-request creation and readback
tasks.currentProblem: Client special-request forms generate idempotency keys and submit through shared controllers, but current package had no exact proof for duplicate submit, attachment/provider failure, actor isolation, status transitions or app restart/readback.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace SHEIN/Awnak commands through shared controller/generated contract to DSH persistence/events/media references; enforce actor ownership, request-type validation, idempotency payload fingerprint, retry/unknown-result handling and canonical list/detail reload.
tasks.targetState: One logical special request produces one owned durable DSH request; duplicate/retry is replay-safe; changed payload under the same identity conflicts; attachments/status remain authorized and survive restart.
tasks.action: Repair DSH special-request owner and persistence before client forms; Media changes only for governed attachment effects.
mustNotChange: Do not hardcode request destination/provider truth in app-client.
Do not create duplicate requests on retry/double tap.
Do not expose another actor's request or attachment.
Do not claim completion from local form state.
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate identical submit converges to one request.
Offline/timeout/provider/media failures remain retryable/unknown as appropriate without fabricated success.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused unit commit or roll forward at the canonical owner while preserving durable/audit evidence; never restore a parallel local truth or weaken a safety boundary.
tasks.commitBoundary: One special-request owner/consumer boundary with media only when directly required.
